description: Multiple-testing correction, permutation test and prioritisation enrichment check for acceptor-site metrics
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, scipy.stats as st, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
base="https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search"
def q(query, fields="accession,id,gene_names,length,sequence,reviewed", size=500):
    r=requests.get(base,params={"query":query,"fields":fields,"format":"json","size":size},timeout=180); r.raise_for_status()
    out=r.json()["results"]
    while "next" in r.links:
        r=requests.get(r.links["next"]["url"],timeout=180); r.raise_for_status(); out.extend(r.json()["results"])
    return out
recs={}
for r in q("(taxonomy_id:6239) AND (xref:pfam-PF01484)")+q("(taxonomy_id:6239) AND (xref:pfam-PF01391)"):
    a=r["primaryAccession"]
    if a in recs: continue
    g=None
    for gg in r.get("genes",[]):
        if gg.get("geneName"): g=gg["geneName"]["value"]; break
    if g is None:
        for gg in r.get("genes",[]):
            for k in ("orderedLocusNames","orfNames"):
                if gg.get(k): g=gg[k][0]["value"]; break
            if g: break
    recs[a]=dict(acc=a,gene=g or a,length=r["sequence"]["length"],seq=r["sequence"]["value"],reviewed=r["entryType"])
df=pd.DataFrame(recs.values()); df["rev"]=(df.reviewed=="UniProtKB reviewed (Swiss-Prot)").astype(int)
can=df.sort_values(["gene","rev","length"],ascending=[True,False,False]).drop_duplicates("gene")
cut=can[~can.gene.isin({"emb-9","let-2","cle-1","col-99","mec-5","unc-122","cof-2","Q6RSA3","Q6RSA2","Q9U9K7"})].reset_index(drop=True)
def gxy(s,m=4):
    n=len(s);R=[];i=0
    while i<n-2:
        if s[i]=='G':
            k=1
            while i+3*k+2<n and s[i+3*k]=='G': k+=1
            if k>=m: R.append((i,k)); i+=3*k; continue
        i+=1
    return R
rows=[]
for _,r in cut.iterrows():
    s=r.seq; R=gxy(s); nt=sum(k for _,k in R); n_can=0; npp=0
    for st_,k in R:
        for t in range(k):
            p=st_+3*t
            if s[p+2]=='P' and p+3<len(s) and s[p+3]=='G':
                n_can+=1
                if s[p+1]=='P': npp+=1
    rows.append(dict(gene=r.gene,acc=r.acc,length=r.length,gxy_trip=nt,GXP_can=n_can,GPP=npp,
        acc_per100trip=100*n_can/nt if nt else np.nan, GPP_per100trip=100*npp/nt if nt else np.nan,
        gxy_frac=3*nt/r.length))
res=pd.DataFrame(rows)
PHENO={'dpy-2','dpy-3','dpy-4','dpy-5','dpy-7','dpy-8','dpy-9','dpy-10','dpy-13','dpy-17','dpy-14','sqt-1','sqt-2','sqt-3','rol-1','rol-6','rol-8','bli-1','bli-2','bli-6','ram-2'}
P4H={'sqt-3','dpy-2','dpy-10','rol-6','sqt-1','dpy-7','bli-1','bli-2'}
res["pheno"]=res.gene.isin(PHENO); res["p4h"]=res.gene.isin(P4H)

tests=[]
for col in ["acc_per100trip","GXP_can","GPP","GPP_per100trip","gxy_frac","length"]:
    for lab,mask in [("pheno",res.pheno),("p4h_link",res.p4h)]:
        a=res.loc[mask,col].dropna(); b=res.loc[~mask,col].dropna()
        u,p=st.mannwhitneyu(a,b)
        sp=np.sqrt(((len(a)-1)*a.var(ddof=1)+(len(b)-1)*b.var(ddof=1))/(len(a)+len(b)-2))
        tests.append(dict(metric=col,group=lab,n=len(a),mean_grp=a.mean(),mean_rest=b.mean(),d=(a.mean()-b.mean())/sp,p_raw=p))
T=pd.DataFrame(tests)
T["p_bonf"]=np.minimum(1,T.p_raw*len(T)); T["q_fdr"]=multipletests(T.p_raw,method="fdr_bh")[1]
print("=== all 12 group comparisons with multiple-testing correction ===")
print(T.round(4).to_string(index=False))

# permutation test for the one nominally significant metric, controlling for protein length
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
obs=res.loc[res.pheno,"GPP_per100trip"].mean()-res.loc[~res.pheno,"GPP_per100trip"].mean()
v=res.GPP_per100trip.values; idx=np.arange(len(res)); k=res.pheno.sum()
null=[]
for _ in range(20000):
    pm=rng.permutation(idx)[:k]; m=np.zeros(len(res),bool); m[pm]=True
    null.append(np.nanmean(v[m])-np.nanmean(v[~m]))
null=np.array(null); pperm=(np.sum(np.abs(null)>=abs(obs))+1)/(len(null)+1)
print(f"\nGPP per 100 triplets, phenotype vs rest: obs diff={obs:+.2f}, permutation p={pperm:.4f} (20000 perms)")
# length-matched permutation
ordr=res.length.rank()
print(f"Spearman(length, GPP_per100trip) rho={st.spearmanr(res.length,res.GPP_per100trip,nan_policy='omit')[0]:+.3f} "
      f"p={st.spearmanr(res.length,res.GPP_per100trip,nan_policy='omit')[1]:.3f}")
print(f"Spearman(length, acc_per100trip) rho={st.spearmanr(res.length,res.acc_per100trip,nan_policy='omit')[0]:+.3f}")

# how well would a density-based top-N list enrich for phenotype collagens?
print("\n=== would ranking by acceptor density prioritise the phenotype collagens? ===")
rk=res.sort_values("acc_per100trip",ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
for N in [10,20,30,50]:
    hit=rk.head(N).pheno.sum(); exp=N*res.pheno.mean()
    pfish=st.hypergeom.sf(hit-1,len(res),res.pheno.sum(),N)
    print(f"  top {N:3d} by density: {hit} of {res.pheno.sum()} phenotype collagens (expected {exp:.1f}), hypergeom p={pfish:.3f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,5))
ax[0].boxplot([res.loc[res.pheno,"acc_per100trip"].dropna(),res.loc[~res.pheno,"acc_per100trip"].dropna()],
              labels=["published cuticle\nphenotype (n=21)","rest (n=155)"],widths=.5)
ax[0].scatter(np.random.normal(1,.05,res.pheno.sum()),res.loc[res.pheno,"acc_per100trip"],s=18,color="#c0392b",zorder=3)
ax[0].set_ylabel("X-Pro-Gly acceptor sites per 100 Gly-X-Y triplets")
ax[0].set_title("Acceptor density does not separate\nphenotype collagens (U p=0.90, d=0.12)")
ax[1].boxplot([res.loc[res.pheno,"GPP_per100trip"].dropna(),res.loc[~res.pheno,"GPP_per100trip"].dropna()],
              labels=["published cuticle\nphenotype (n=21)","rest (n=155)"],widths=.5)
ax[1].scatter(np.random.normal(1,.05,res.pheno.sum()),res.loc[res.pheno,"GPP_per100trip"],s=18,color="#c0392b",zorder=3)
ax[1].set_ylabel("Gly-Pro-Pro triplets per 100 Gly-X-Y triplets")
ax[1].set_title("Gly-Pro-Pro density: nominal difference only\n(d=0.67, raw p=0.007, FDR q=0.08)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
res.to_csv("/tmp/final_ranking.csv",index=False); T.to_csv("/tmp/group_tests.csv",index=False)
